007package com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent;
008
009import com.fasterxml.jackson.core.JsonProcessingException;
010import com.fasterxml.jackson.core.type.TypeReference;
011import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.DeserializationFeature;
012import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
013
014import java.util.ArrayList;
015import java.util.Collections;
016import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
017import java.util.List;
018import java.util.Map;
019
020/**
021 * Typed runtime parameters for {@code DBMS_CLOUD_AI_AGENT.RUN_TEAM}.
022 *
023 * <p>The model represents the documented runtime parameter groups and
024 * serializes them to the JSON CLOB expected by the database package. Values
025 * supplied in maps are snapshotted when the builder method is called, so later
026 * caller mutations cannot change a request that has already been built.
027 * Decimal values are retained as {@link java.math.BigDecimal} rather than
028 * rounded to binary floating-point values during the snapshot.</p>
029 *
030 * <p>For runnable examples, see
031 * <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/RunTeamSample.html">
032 * RunTeamSample source</a> and
033 * <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/RunTeamParamsSample.html">
034 * RunTeamParamsSample source</a>.</p>
035 *
036 * @since 1.1.0
037 */
038public final class RunTeamParams {
039    /** JSON mapper used to snapshot and serialize runtime values. */
040    private static final ObjectMapper MAPPER = new ObjectMapper()
041            .enable(DeserializationFeature.USE_BIG_DECIMAL_FOR_FLOATS);
042
043    /** Optional database conversation identifier. */
044    private final String conversationId;
045    /** Values substituted into task instructions. */
046    private final Map<String, Object> instructionVariables;
047    /** Values that override configurable agent or tool attributes. */
048    private final Map<String, Object> attributeVariables;
049    /** Values shared between tools during a team run. */
050    private final Map<String, Object> stateVariables;
051
052    private RunTeamParams(Builder builder) {
053        this.conversationId = builder.conversationId;
054        this.instructionVariables = builder.instructionVariables;
055        this.attributeVariables = builder.attributeVariables;
056        this.stateVariables = builder.stateVariables;
057    }
058
059    /**
060     * Creates a builder for team runtime parameters.
061     *
062     * @return mutable builder for team runtime parameters
063     */
064    public static Builder builder() {
065        return new Builder();
066    }
067
068    /**
069     * Creates parameters for one database conversation.
070     *
071     * @param conversationId database-created conversation identifier
072     * @return immutable team runtime parameters
073     * @throws IllegalArgumentException when the identifier is null or blank
074     */
075    public static RunTeamParams forConversationId(String conversationId) {
076        return builder().conversationId(conversationId).build();
077    }
078
079    /**
080     * Returns the optional database conversation identifier.
081     *
082     * @return conversation identifier, or {@code null} when unset
083     */
084    public String getConversationId() {
085        return conversationId;
086    }
087
088    /**
089     * Returns instruction variables, or {@code null} when unset.
090     *
091     * @return immutable instruction variables, or {@code null}
092     */
093    public Map<String, Object> getInstructionVariables() {
094        return instructionVariables;
095    }
096
097    /**
098     * Returns attribute variables, or {@code null} when unset.
099     *
100     * @return immutable attribute variables, or {@code null}
101     */
102    public Map<String, Object> getAttributeVariables() {
103        return attributeVariables;
104    }
105
106    /**
107     * Returns state variables, or {@code null} when unset.
108     *
109     * @return immutable state variables, or {@code null}
110     */
111    public Map<String, Object> getStateVariables() {
112        return stateVariables;
113    }
114
115    /**
116     * Serializes these parameters for the database package.
117     *
118     * @return JSON object, or {@code null} when no parameters were supplied
119     */
120    public String toParamsJson() {
121        Map<String, Object> params = new LinkedHashMap<>();
122        if (conversationId != null) {
123            params.put("conversation_id", conversationId);
124        }
125        if (instructionVariables != null) {
126            params.put("instruction_variables", instructionVariables);
127        }
128        if (attributeVariables != null) {
129            params.put("attribute_variables", attributeVariables);
130        }
131        if (stateVariables != null) {
132            params.put("state_variables", stateVariables);
133        }
134        if (params.isEmpty()) {
135            return null;
136        }
137        try {
138            return MAPPER.writeValueAsString(params);
139        } catch (JsonProcessingException e) {
140            throw new IllegalStateException("Failed to serialize RunTeamParams", e);
141        }
142    }
143
144    /** Builder for immutable team runtime parameters. */
145    public static final class Builder {
146        /** Optional database conversation identifier. */
147        private String conversationId;
148        /** Values substituted into task instructions. */
149        private Map<String, Object> instructionVariables;
150        /** Values that override configurable agent or tool attributes. */
151        private Map<String, Object> attributeVariables;
152        /** Values shared between tools during a team run. */
153        private Map<String, Object> stateVariables;
154
155        private Builder() {
156        }
157
158        /**
159         * Sets an application-managed conversation identifier.
160         *
161         * @param conversationId database-created conversation identifier
162         * @return this builder
163         * @throws IllegalArgumentException when the identifier is null or blank
164         */
165        public Builder conversationId(String conversationId) {
166            if (conversationId == null || conversationId.isBlank()) {
167                throw new IllegalArgumentException("conversationId must not be null or blank");
168            }
169            this.conversationId = conversationId;
170            return this;
171        }
172
173        /**
174         * Sets instruction variables as a snapshot of a JSON-compatible map.
175         *
176         * @param instructionVariables values substituted into task instructions
177         * @return this builder
178         * @throws IllegalArgumentException when the map is not JSON-compatible
179         */
180        public Builder instructionVariables(Map<String, ?> instructionVariables) {
181            this.instructionVariables = snapshotVariables(instructionVariables, "instructionVariables");
182            return this;
183        }
184
185        /**
186         * Sets attribute variables as a snapshot of a JSON-compatible map.
187         *
188         * @param attributeVariables values that override configurable attributes
189         * @return this builder
190         * @throws IllegalArgumentException when the map is not JSON-compatible
191         */
192        public Builder attributeVariables(Map<String, ?> attributeVariables) {
193            this.attributeVariables = snapshotVariables(attributeVariables, "attributeVariables");
194            return this;
195        }
196
197        /**
198         * Sets state variables as a snapshot of a JSON-compatible map.
199         *
200         * @param stateVariables values shared between tools during a run
201         * @return this builder
202         * @throws IllegalArgumentException when the map is not JSON-compatible
203         */
204        public Builder stateVariables(Map<String, ?> stateVariables) {
205            this.stateVariables = snapshotVariables(stateVariables, "stateVariables");
206            return this;
207        }
208
209        /**
210         * Builds immutable team runtime parameters.
211         *
212         * @return immutable team runtime parameters
213         */
214        public RunTeamParams build() {
215            return new RunTeamParams(this);
216        }
217    }
218
219    private static Map<String, Object> snapshotVariables(Map<String, ?> values, String fieldName) {
220        if (values == null) {
221            return null;
222        }
223        try {
224            Map<String, Object> parsed = MAPPER.readValue(MAPPER.writeValueAsString(values),
225                    new TypeReference<>() { });
226            return immutableMap(parsed);
227        } catch (JsonProcessingException e) {
228            throw new IllegalArgumentException(fieldName + " must be JSON-compatible", e);
229        }
230    }
231
232    private static Map<String, Object> immutableMap(Map<String, Object> source) {
233        Map<String, Object> copy = new LinkedHashMap<>();
234        source.forEach((key, value) -> copy.put(key, immutableJsonValue(value)));
235        return Collections.unmodifiableMap(copy);
236    }
237
238    private static Object immutableJsonValue(Object value) {
239        if (value instanceof Map<?, ?> map) {
240            Map<String, Object> copy = new LinkedHashMap<>();
241            map.forEach((key, entry) -> {
242                if (!(key instanceof String stringKey)) {
243                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Runtime parameter map keys must be strings");
244                }
245                copy.put(stringKey, immutableJsonValue(entry));
246            });
247            return Collections.unmodifiableMap(copy);
248        }
249        if (value instanceof List<?> list) {
250            List<Object> copy = new ArrayList<>(list.size());
251            list.forEach(entry -> copy.add(immutableJsonValue(entry)));
252            return Collections.unmodifiableList(copy);
253        }
254        return value;
255    }
256}
